semantics.meaning: a real rendered audio asset from the authorized music lane exists, is technically valid, and is bound to exact bytes with complete render provenance
checks: duration matches recorded ffprobe measurement within 0.5s
not: not the final program mix (no program-mix render path exists yet)
not human music approval (Scorecraft two-step gate remains the only approval authority)
not Scorecraft planning output (cue sheets / MIDI never satisfy render evidence)

canonical_producer.why_not_new_agent: mission §6 — the department already owns the records; infrastructure rendered the audio; attester is deterministic
canonical_producer.why_not_generation_supervisor: generation lane renders the candidate; the department's candidate record is what QC's adapter contract names

qc_wrong_hash.meaning: hash binding enforced by QC itself: a bind hash that does not match the inspected artifact is STALE, never trusted

cases: AR2 real decodable audio satisfies QC (hermetic)
AR6 audio changed after evidence -> AUDIO_RENDER_STALE
AR7 evidence bound to another artifact -> QC_EVIDENCE_ARTIFACT_MISMATCH
AR10 sample rate / channels measured, not invented (48k mono)
AR12 supersession: v1 evidence does not satisfy v2 render
AR13 human approval recorded truthfully, never invented
AR14 bounded canary production bytes accepted by QC
AR15 invariant: zero mandatory producer-less evidence kinds

retained_canary_applicability.reason: gate 7 is the capture phase; that run's program audio comes from real presenter capture, not the music lane. Fabricating audio there would be dishonest. Bounded dedicated canary used instead (mission §39).
retained_canary_applicability.control_room: no agent invocation fabricated; attester is deterministic infrastructure

mode_dependency_flag: If DRAFT/REVIEW/PRODUCTION run modes land (sibling mission b329cc9/81dccf8/9492d84), AUDIO_RENDER expectations may differ per mode. Not consumed here — read-only observation; contract assumes the music lane's production render.

lifecycle_trigger.rationale: music rendering is project-scoped in Scorecraft (not every package run gets music); materialization belongs where a run's soundtrack is chosen, which the current lifecycle has not reached for any genuine run. Wiring a speculative trigger would invent lifecycle ordering without evidence (mission §21).

stop_reason: AUDIO_RENDER PATH PROVEN: semantics explicit, canonical producer exists, real render validated against actual bytes, QC accepts it through the real runner, stale/wrong/undecodable audio fails closed, required-evidence inventory has zero unexplained mandatory producer-less kinds.
